Author: Aelinore
Description:
[b][size=2]Last change: Feb 6, 2025 - Added Cape Stardew portraits.[/size]

[size=4]About:[/size][/b][size=2] Started off doing these for my own game but, with permission, decided to share! These are edited Nyapu portraits made to fit characters that are not on Nyapu's to-do or by-some-chance list. 

[i][color=#000000][size=4][b]* Due to school and work life, I have no idea when I will have the time to update or fix any of my mods. So long as it is non-profit/non-commercial and the original is linked back to, I am 10000% OK with others using my work and publishing UPDATES/UPDATED versions. If other mod author's assets are used in my mod, you must get their permission before publishing any updates. Thank-you for downloading my original and I'm sorry I haven't been able to update. :( * [u]I will post, if given permission, any personal edits/portraits I've made for my own playthroughs but am no longer taking requests or actively updating this mod.[/u][/b][/size][/color][/i]

[/size][b][size=4]Required:[/size][/b]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits inspired by Dong [/url][i][size=1](Optional, but this mod was meant to be used with these!)[/size][/i]

[b][size=4]Install:
[/size][/b][i]These are replacer portraits, meaning you'll have to overwrite the original portraits for these to work. I do not have the time or know-how to make them into [CP] files, I am sorry!
[/i]1. Ensure you have all the required mods for the NPC and for the portraits to function.
2. Download the portrait mod .zip file.
3. Open the .zip file and move the contents to your Stardew Valley mod and overwrite the original files.
[b]If you need more help with installation, please check out the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/1621]Articles tab[/url]![/b]

[u][size=4]FAQ:
[/size][/u][b]Why are you posting new portraits while on hiatus?[/b]
- If given the OK by mod authors, I'm sharing portraits that I've made FOR MY OWN PLAYTHROUGH/USE. I figured I'd share them for others to use as well. 

[b]Updated for 1.6?[/b]
- I do not have the time currently to update any mods. My permissions are open to those who wanna use/edit/update these SO LONG as you get permission from any mod authors, permission from anyone who's assets were used, and so long as it's not for profit or commercial purposes.

[b]Play tested?[/b]
- Only the replacer versions have been tested, the content patcher versions are untested.


[b]Content Patcher version or Replacer version?[/b]
- I recommend the replacer portraits, if possible. I am not familiar with coding and they [CP] versions may not work as intended. [u]Do not report [CP] versions as bugs if they do not work correctly[/u]. I'm offering them as-is right now and am tired of the headaches trying to make them. xD USE REPLACERS, PLS.
[b]I give permission to others to convert these to [CP] mod packs!
[/b]

[b]Some characters have seasonal portraits, did you include them here?[/b]
- Yes, unless additional portraits were uploaded after these were published. 

[b]Some portraits look better than others, what gives?[/b]
- Some portraits, especially the early ones, won't look as good as newer ones as I get better with editing. I have very little experience with pixel art, but I'm trying! :^D

[b]Can I edit these and share them?[/b]
- As long as you have permission from the original mod creators, I'm fine with my edits being... Well, edited! 

[b]Will you do portraits for xxx mod? [/b]
- As of now, I am not taking any requests. I do not have the time to properly maintain this mod.
